'''Docking Bay 64''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] in the [[Mos Ila Spaceport]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR:TtS" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> a Bounty [[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]] participating in the [[Great Hunt (c. 3643 BBY)|Great Hunt]] confronted the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Gault Rennow|Tyresius Lokai]] in the docking bay.<ref name="TOR:TtS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Docking Bay 64 appears as an area on Tatooine in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Bounty Hunter class mission.<ref name="TOR:TtS" />
